raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Some raw_transactions rows, such as batch 14, carry lowercase customer_ids like 'c00180', while raw_customers uses uppercase 'C00180'. The inner join in gold_region_daily silently drops those rows (4630 vs 4267), and gold_customer_spend splits one customer into two keys. Normalising customer_id in silver_transactions fixes both.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, upper(trim(customer_id)) AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
